units.source_text: “我们信仰基督教、佛教、伊斯兰教、拜火教什么的。

en.t: We believe in Christianity, Buddhism, Islam, Zoroastrianism, and the like.

units.source_text: 势力最大的要数近代教了。

en.t: The most powerful of them is the modern faith.
It is also called the religion of life.

units.source_text: （“生活教”这个词的翻译可能不够贴切。

en.t: The translation of the term "religion of life" may not be quite apt.
In the original, the word is Quemoocha.
The cha probably corresponds to the English suffix ism.

units.source_text: Quemoo的原形Quemal不单指“生活”，还包括“饮食男女”的意思。）

en.t: The original form of Quemoo, Quemal, does not mean only "life"; it also includes the sense of food, drink, and sexual relations.
